title: Civil War III (miniquest)
start: Speak to Anne Dimitri in the Wilderness.

recommended.t: Sand seed or mystical sand seed for fast access to the Garden of Kharid
Power Planter I achievement completed before starting the quest for faster completion.

steps.t: Talk to Anne Dimitri, who is just north of Quercus in the Wilderness. [Chat: Accept]
Head to the Garden of Kharid and talk to Polletix. [Chat: 1 How's it going? (Civil War III)]

sub.t: If you haven't done so already, complete the Power Planter I achievement, which involves earning 250 Crux Eqal favour and purchasing the first unlock in Sydekix's Shop of Balance. You can earn favour by planting and harvesting herbs from any herb patch in the game, including the one in the Garden of Kharid. You can ask the daily herb from Polletix, and planting and harvesting the daily herb always grants the maximum of 50 favour per seed. Planting the daily herb in five patches will satisfy this requirement. Herb protector can ensure that the patches do not become diseased and is fairly inexpensive to purchase.
If you hadn't completed the achievement before, talk to Polletix again. [Chat: 1 How's it going? (Civil War III)]

steps.t: Return to Anne Dimitri and talk to her.
Head to the White Knights' Castle throne room (floor 2) and talk to Adrasteia.

get_inside.text: Four types of abyssal demons roam around the obelisk and the north entrance of Forinthry Dungeon.
